The Indian Men’s Hockey Team took on Belgium in their concluding clash at the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, playing out a thrilling 3–3 draw before narrowly going down 3–4 in the shootout in the 7th/8th place clash.
Harmanpreet Singh stepped up in the final minute to level the scores and send the game into a shootout, where Belgium edged India to close out the campaign.
Watch the highlights from the India vs Belgium clash as the Indian Men’s Team signed off their World Cup campaign.
